rounds.text: Earthstahl & Alloys Ltd is currently priced at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, trading at a price-to-book ratio of just 0.55x [E1, E47]. Management is actively deleveraging the balance sheet, successfully reducing total borrowings from Rs 18.30 Cr to Rs 14.88 Cr year-over-year [E31]. The company operates within the Capital Goods sector, which currently benefits from a positive tailwind score of +0.67 [E59]. Furthermore, foreign institutional interest has emerged, with holdings increasing from 0.00% to 0.88% over the last three years [E34]. Conceded: the company faces severe profitability challenges, including a -1025% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months and a negative return on equity [E16, E12].
